title: listallpatients
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/clinical/patients/ correctly returns a list of all patients with appropriate data fields and status code 200.

title: listallvisits
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/clinical/visits/ correctly returns a list of all patient visits with appropriate data fields and status code 200.

title: getvisitdetails
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/clinical/visits/{visit_id}/ returns the correct visit details for a valid visit_id with status code 200, and handles invalid visit_id appropriately.

title: updatevisitstatus
description: Verify that the API endpoint POST /api/clinical/visits/{visit_id}/update-status/ successfully updates the status of the specified visit and returns status code 200.

title: listallconsents
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/consent/consents/ returns a list of all consents with status code 200.

title: createconsent
description: Verify that the API endpoint POST /api/consent/consents/ creates a new consent record with valid input data and returns status code 201.

title: checkconsentforoperation
description: Verify that the API endpoint POST /api/consent/consent/check/ correctly checks consent for a given patient, purpose, data categories, and action, returning the consent check result with status code 200.

title: listallpermissions
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/policies/permissions/ returns a list of all permissions with status code 200.

title: listallroles
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/policies/roles/ returns a list of all roles with status code 200.

title: getuserpermissions
description: Verify that the API endpoint GET /api/policies/user-permissions/ returns the permissions assigned to the authenticated user with status code 200.
